# AI Site Scan

> AI Site Scan checks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI can reach, read and understand a website. You enter an address and get an AI readiness score from 0 to 100, a side-by-side view of what a visitor and an AI tool see, a test of 14 AI bots, 23 agent-readiness checks, an agent usability grade (can ChatGPT agent, Claude in Chrome and Gemini use the page) and a ranked list of fixes.

The scan is free and needs no login. The full report, with steps and ready-to-paste code for every fix, costs $19 once for one site (with 1 rescan within 30 days), or $29 a month for Pro with 10 reports a month. Buyers log in with an email code or Google; reports are emailed and saved in their account. Payments run on Polar, the merchant of record.

## Main pages

- [AI Site Scan](https://getaisitescan.com/): free AI readiness check for any website
- [llms.txt checker and generator](https://getaisitescan.com/llms-txt): checks a site's llms.txt and writes one from the site's own pages
- [AI robots.txt checker](https://getaisitescan.com/ai-robots-txt): tests whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and 11 more AI bots can read a site
- [About](https://getaisitescan.com/about): who makes AI Site Scan and how the score works
- [Sample report](https://getaisitescan.com/sample): a real full report for react.dev, score 63 to 90, fixes with code and an agent grade
- [Compare](https://getaisitescan.com/compare): AI Site Scan vs HubSpot AI Search Grader, Semrush AI Agent Readiness, Hostinger AI Visibility Checker, Cloudflare isitagentready.com and Otterly.AI, with sources
- [How we test](https://getaisitescan.com/how-we-test): the three kinds of AI we test (search crawlers, agents that read the page, agents that look at the screen), every agent check, its limits and sources
- [Pricing](https://getaisitescan.com/pricing): free check, $19 full report for 1 site, Pro at $29 a month for 10 reports
- [Contact](https://getaisitescan.com/contact): support email and business details
